rules.shared_boundary: The exact previous end image is the next scene's start image; revise the next target frame until its geometry, identity and size match before video rendering.
rules.camera_cut: Different plate crop; never interpolate actor scale as if the actor grew or shrank. A deliberate zoom needs its own registered camera move and endpoint review.
rules.same_view_motion_candidate: Same plate and crop only; compare the real pixels, character anatomy, landmark ratios, depth and ground contact before using as start/end of one moving clip.
rules.timing: Whole-line unit boundaries are known; exact cuts within long lines still need word alignment.
